title: AICU surface manifest (.aicu/surface.yml)
description: Declares the production surfaces (public hosts) a repository serves and the conditions for retiring them. Where things run is already known to the hosting provider; this file records only what cannot be derived from it: intent, ownership, and retirement conditions.

entity.description: Which company owns this asset. AICU Inc. and AICU Japan K.K. are separate companies with separate strategies.

role.description: What this surface does and who it is for. One line.

owner.description: Contact that outlives any one person: an X or GitHub handle ("@AICUai"), a team alias, or a URL. Not a personal email address.

hosts.description: Hostnames served. Empty list if there is no host (books, libraries, experiments).

paths.description: Paths this repository owns on a host shared with other repositories. Without them, traffic cannot be attributed.

resources.description: Cloudflare resources used only by this surface. Needed to decide quickly whether an unused resource can be deleted.

status.description: planned=not public yet / live=serving / maintenance=serving, no longer developed / retiring=being removed / retired=removed

review.description: Input for retirement decisions. The same discipline as token issuance: every surface has a next review date and an expiry condition.

retire_when.description: What has to happen for this to be retired. "Undecided" is allowed; blank is not.
